commands.name: login
commands.description: Authenticate with Conductor via browser. Opens a browser window to complete OAuth; credentials are saved locally.

options.description: Re-authenticate even if already logged in

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize Conductor in the current project. Links the project, installs the Claude Code plugin, and starts the sync daemon.

options.description: Project ID to link (skips interactive selection)
Project directory to initialize (defaults to current directory)

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start the Conductor file watcher daemon. Watches local issue files and syncs changes to the backend.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show daemon running state and sync queue depth.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Start the MCP stdio server for Claude Code integration. Claude Code invokes this automatically via the MCP configuration set up by conductor init.

commands.name: dashboard
commands.description: Show a live Conductor status dashboard in the terminal. Renders as a one-shot status summary when output is piped.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Run health checks on your Conductor setup: config, API connectivity, MCP server, and plugin installation.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Lint local Conductor PRD and tasks.json artifacts against the current schema. Useful for catching format errors before pushing.

commands.name: config show
commands.description: Display the current CLI configuration. The API key is redacted.

commands.name: config use
commands.description: Switch to a named environment. Currently supported: prod.

commands.name: config set-url
commands.description: Update the API base URL. Use when running a self-hosted backend.

claudeIntegration.description: Conductor ships a full Claude Code plugin — slash commands, skills, and a background agent — installed automatically by conductor init into your Claude Code configuration.

slashCommands.name: conductor:prd
slashCommands.description: Create a PRD for the current project through guided discovery, research, and writing.

slashCommands.name: conductor:implement
slashCommands.description: Take a PRD issue from BACKLOG to a green PR — status transitions, branch, parallel coding agents, CI monitoring.

slashCommands.name: conductor:fix
slashCommands.description: Fix a bug found during PR review — root cause investigation, full build validation, push to the existing PR branch.

slashCommands.name: conductor:workflow
slashCommands.description: Design and create a Conductor workflow — YAML automation or statechart lifecycle — via guided discovery and MCP creation.

agents.name: conductor-researcher
agents.description: Researches unfamiliar technologies, libraries, and APIs for PRD creation. Auto-triggered by conductor:prd when confidence is low.

skills.name: conductor-coder
skills.description: Conductor-native coding agent. Implements tasks TDD-style: writes tests first, implements until passing, commits with task ref.

skills.name: conductor-ux-ui-design
skills.description: Expert UX/UI design guidance for creating simple, user-focused interfaces. Applies human-centered design principles.

skills.name: conductor-publisher
skills.description: Schedules and tracks a Post through the publishing pipeline: gathers copy, destinations and timing, checks content, creates it with create_post, reports the confirmation table, follows it through review and publishing.

mcpTools.name: create_work_item
mcpTools.description: Create a new Work Item in the project. Discover-then-create: call list_workflows({kind:"LIFECYCLE"}) first to pick the governing Workflow slug.

mcpTools.name: update_work_item
mcpTools.description: Update an existing Work Item's title, description, or schedule (scheduledFor + scheduleTimezone).

mcpTools.name: set_work_item_status
mcpTools.description: Update the status of a Work Item directly. For Workflow-validated moves prefer transition_work_item.

mcpTools.name: list_work_items
mcpTools.description: List Work Items in the project, optionally filtered by type, status, or Workflow.

mcpTools.name: get_work_item
mcpTools.description: Get a single Work Item by ID, including its current status and linked documents.

mcpTools.name: scaffold_document
mcpTools.description: Create an empty document file locally and register it with the backend. Returns absolutePath for use with the Write tool. Prefer write_document in headless containers.

mcpTools.name: write_document
mcpTools.description: Create or update a Work Item document by filename with full content (upsert). Works headlessly — supersedes scaffold_document+Write for new documents.

mcpTools.name: delete_document
mcpTools.description: Delete a document from a Work Item, both locally and from the backend.

mcpTools.name: list_work_item_comments
mcpTools.description: List comments on a Work Item, optionally filtered by resolved status.

mcpTools.name: list_workflows
mcpTools.description: List the project's Workflows. Discovery entry point — resolves workflow names to slugs before creating a Work Item.

mcpTools.name: get_available_transitions
mcpTools.description: Get the valid next statuses for a Work Item from its current status. Review-gated transitions are hidden until approved.

mcpTools.name: transition_work_item
mcpTools.description: Move a Work Item to a new status. Backend validates against the active Workflow and Review gate.

mcpTools.name: record_asset
mcpTools.description: Record a produced-output Asset on a Work Item (e.g. a github_pr link). Type is validated against the Workflow's asset_types.

mcpTools.name: report_step_run
mcpTools.description: Report an agent-run step on a Work Item for human review at a Review gate: what was asked, what was produced, any flags.

mcpTools.name: create_workflow
mcpTools.description: Create a new workflow definition in DRAFT state. Returns workflowId.

mcpTools.name: get_workflow
mcpTools.description: Get a workflow definition by ID. Call after create_workflow or update_workflow to verify the change was stored correctly.

mcpTools.name: update_workflow
mcpTools.description: Update a DRAFT workflow definition. Fix validation errors before retrying publish — do not create a second workflow.

mcpTools.name: delete_workflow
mcpTools.description: Delete a DRAFT workflow definition. PUBLISHED and DISABLED workflows are rejected — prefer update_workflow to fix a DRAFT in place.

mcpTools.name: publish_workflow
mcpTools.description: Promote a workflow from DRAFT to PUBLISHED. Returns success and any validation errors.

mcpTools.name: dispatch_workflow
mcpTools.description: Manually trigger a workflow run for testing. Returns runId. Only works on PUBLISHED YAML automation workflows.

mcpTools.name: cancel_workflow_run
mcpTools.description: Cancel a PENDING or RUNNING workflow run. Idempotent while already CANCELLING; fails once the run has finished.

mcpTools.name: get_workflow_run
mcpTools.description: Get status and step details for a workflow run (PENDING/RUNNING/SUCCESS/FAILED). Call after dispatch_workflow to verify the run.

mcpTools.name: list_workflow_runs
mcpTools.description: List recent runs for a workflow (newest first): runId, status, triggerType, timings.

mcpTools.name: list_workflow_secrets
mcpTools.description: List the names of workflow secrets configured for this project (keys only — values are never returned over MCP).

mcpTools.name: get_workflow_step_schema
mcpTools.description: The live, authoritative reference for workflow YAML: every step type's fields plus valid ${{ }}/if: interpolation roots and functions, read from the engine's schema registry.

mcpTools.name: list_integration_tools
mcpTools.description: List connected integrations and their available data operations for workflow authoring. Always call before designing a workflow.

mcpTools.name: list_connector_catalog
mcpTools.description: List all connector types Conductor supports (connected or not), with capabilities and config fields. Use to recommend integrations to connect.

mcpTools.name: list_agents
mcpTools.description: List the project's named AI Agents (id, slug, provider, model, state). Discovery for workflow authoring.

mcpTools.name: create_agent
mcpTools.description: Create a named AI Agent in the project (provider, model, system prompt, tool bindings, guardrails).

mcpTools.name: update_agent
mcpTools.description: Update an existing AI Agent. Partial — only the supplied fields change. Also how an ACTIVE agent is set back to DRAFT so it can be deleted.

mcpTools.name: delete_agent
mcpTools.description: Delete a DRAFT AI Agent. An ACTIVE agent is rejected — set it to DRAFT with update_agent first. Also rejected if a workflow still references this agent.

mcpTools.name: list_skills
mcpTools.description: List the Claude Code skills a lifecycle Workflow may bind from a skill transition step: shipped built-ins plus project-registered skills.

mcpTools.name: register_skill
mcpTools.description: Register a project-scoped skill id so a lifecycle Workflow can bind it from a transition step and publish without a backend redeploy.

mcpTools.name: submit_knowledge_source
mcpTools.description: Push an observation, event, or document into the project's knowledge inbox for the librarian to file into wiki pages.

mcpTools.name: read_knowledge_sources
mcpTools.description: Fetch knowledge-inbox sources by id, with offloaded payload content resolved inline.

mcpTools.name: search_knowledge
mcpTools.description: Search the project wiki for pages matching a query: path, type, title, description, snippet, rank per hit.

mcpTools.name: read_knowledge_pages
mcpTools.description: Fetch full content of wiki pages by path. Pass ["index.md"] for wiki orientation.

mcpTools.name: write_knowledge_pages
mcpTools.description: Create, update, or delete wiki pages atomically. Updating requires the page's current version as baseVersion.

mcpTools.name: list_knowledge_domains
mcpTools.description: List this project's knowledge domains — slug, displayName, description, pathPrefix, filing conventions.

mcpTools.name: suggest_knowledge_domain
mcpTools.description: Raise a gap report for a knowledge domain not yet in the registry. Claim-or-return on slug.

mcpTools.name: list_project_docs
mcpTools.description: Map the project's Docs section — folder paths and every document as a "Folder/Title" path, or full-text search with query.

mcpTools.name: read_project_doc
mcpTools.description: Read one project document by path or docId — full Markdown plus taskLines (every checkbox with its line number and state).

mcpTools.name: write_project_doc
mcpTools.description: Create or replace a project document at a path, creating any missing folders.

mcpTools.name: move_project_doc
mcpTools.description: Rename a project document and/or move it to another folder.

mcpTools.name: delete_project_doc
mcpTools.description: Delete a project document, along with its version history and comments.

mcpTools.name: set_project_doc_task
mcpTools.description: Check or uncheck one Markdown checkbox in a project document by 1-based line number.

mcpTools.name: list_project_doc_comments
mcpTools.description: Read the line-anchored comments humans left on a project document, unresolved by default.

mcpTools.name: comment_on_project_doc
mcpTools.description: Leave a comment anchored to one line of a project document.

mcpTools.name: respond_to_project_doc_comment
mcpTools.description: Answer a comment thread on a project document — reply, resolve, or both.

mcpTools.name: list_project_doc_versions
mcpTools.description: List a project document's edit history — version number, author and timestamp, newest first.

mcpTools.name: restore_project_doc_version
mcpTools.description: Roll a project document back to an earlier version, appended as a new version rather than a rewind.

mcpTools.name: upload_project_doc_image
mcpTools.description: Upload a local image file to a project document and get the Markdown snippet to embed.

mcpTools.name: move_project_folder
mcpTools.description: Rename a docs folder and/or move it under another one, taking its whole subtree with it.

mcpTools.name: delete_project_folder
mcpTools.description: Delete a docs folder and its subfolders; documents inside are kept and resurface at the project root.

mcpTools.name: list_publish_targets
mcpTools.description: Accounts a project can publish to (with each platform's option keys), plus a Work Item's selected targets and outcomes.

mcpTools.name: set_publish_targets
mcpTools.description: Replace which connected accounts a Work Item publishes to, with per-target publish options.

mcpTools.name: upload_asset
mcpTools.description: Attach a media file to a Work Item from a local path or a public URL in one call; MP4/MOV are measured here.

mcpTools.name: complete_manual_publish
mcpTools.description: Record that a MANUAL publish target was published by hand, storing the live URL.

mcpTools.name: retry_failed_publish_targets
mcpTools.description: Re-fire only the failed publish targets on a Work Item.

mcpTools.name: list_assets
mcpTools.description: Every Asset on a Work Item — uploaded media and recorded links, with the ids set_publish_targets takes.

mcpTools.name: create_post
mcpTools.description: Create, schedule and submit a Post in one call: caption, media (paths or URLs), destinations by account name, fire time, reviewers.

mcpTools.name: get_post_status
mcpTools.description: Where a Post stands: status, every destination's outcome, the gate's blockers and warnings, review and consent state, next step.

mcpTools.name: submit_post
mcpTools.description: Hand a Post to review: assign reviewers and take the move the gate names, if nothing blocks it.

mcpTools.name: list_posts
mcpTools.description: Posts across every publishing Workflow with their destinations, filtered by status, schedule window or platform.

mcpTools.name: submit_review
mcpTools.description: Record an approve / request_changes verdict on a Post as this API key's user (an assigned REVIEWER). Approval schedules the Post.

mcpTools.name: get_post_analytics
mcpTools.description: Views, likes, comments and shares per destination of a Post, as the platform reports them, with snapshots over time.

mcpTools.name: list_top_posts
mcpTools.description: The project's best-performing published destinations ranked by one metric.
